paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic Axion haloscope at ma = 58µeV
notes: First direct experimental measurement of axion-electron coupling (gaee) for dark matter axions. QUAX ferromagnetic haloscope using five 1mm GaYIG spheres at 14 GHz (58.5 µeV). Seven measurement runs spanning ~3 MHz due to apparatus drift. Flat exclusion limit gaee < 4.9×10^-10 at 95% CL derived from Eq. 10 analysis of noise power spectra. 0.98 dB antenna matching loss and factor-of-2 binning search correction applied. Sensitivity limited by thermal fluctuations and receiver noise at T~5K. DFSZ model.
